blocks.content: Mohsen Rezaee, a former commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, was appointed on 9 August 2026 as a representative to Iran’s Supreme National Security Council and as its secretary and head. The appointment was issued by President Masoud Pezeshkian and followed the resignation of Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr from the same post.

items: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps was established in 1979 after the Iranian Revolution.
The Supreme National Security Council was created under the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Iran.
The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow maritime passage between the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
The Expediency Discernment Council is involved in resolving disputes between Iran’s Parliament and the Guardian Council.
